posts.text: Bharat's Reform Express won't stop. At Bharat Innovates, I told the world: we are turning challenges into opportunities, powering growth through innovation, technology and global partnerships. India is the trusted partner for this new era of progress.
posts.caption: Bharat's Reform Express won't stop. At Bharat Innovates, I told the world: we are turning challenges into opportunities, powering growth through innovation, technology and global partnerships. India is the trusted partner for this new era of progress.

posts.text: PM @narendramodi heads to the G7 Summit in Évian, France. India's voice on the global stage grows stronger by the day, with a series of bilateral meetings planned to deepen strategic cooperation and partnership.
posts.caption: PM @narendramodi heads to the G7 Summit in Évian, France. India's voice on the global stage grows stronger by the day, with a series of bilateral meetings planned to deepen strategic cooperation and partnership.

posts.text: Under PM @narendramodi's leadership, we have delivered on every promise made to the people — a stronger, more secure India where development reaches the last person in the queue. A Viksit Bharat is not a slogan, it is our resolve.
posts.caption: Under PM @narendramodi's leadership, we have delivered on every promise made to the people — a stronger, more secure India where development reaches the last person in the queue. A Viksit Bharat is not a slogan, it is our resolve.

posts.text: Three Indian sailors lost their lives, and a compromised PM will not defend the nation's honour. Na afsoos, na maafi. India's dignity cannot be outsourced to Washington — our strategic autonomy must be defended with clarity and resolve.
posts.caption: Three Indian sailors lost their lives, and a compromised PM will not defend the nation's honour. Na afsoos, na maafi. India's dignity cannot be outsourced to Washington — our strategic autonomy must be defended with clarity and resolve.

posts.text: Answering PM Modi's appeal, we have cut ministerial convoys across UP by 50% and urge every citizen to conserve fuel amid the West Asia crisis. Discipline and austerity today secure a stronger tomorrow.
posts.caption: Answering PM Modi's appeal, we have cut ministerial convoys across UP by 50% and urge every citizen to conserve fuel amid the West Asia crisis. Discipline and austerity today secure a stronger tomorrow.

posts.text: The Centre must raise the killing of our seafarers directly with President Trump. Diplomatic silence is not an option when Indian lives are lost. The nation expects the government to stand up for its own people.
posts.caption: The Centre must raise the killing of our seafarers directly with President Trump. Diplomatic silence is not an option when Indian lives are lost. The nation expects the government to stand up for its own people.

posts.text: Conveyed India's strong protest to @SecRubio over the death of three Indian nationals. The safety and security of our citizens and seafarers is paramount, and we expect it to be fully respected. India will defend its interests firmly.
posts.caption: Conveyed India's strong protest to @SecRubio over the death of three Indian nationals. The safety and security of our citizens and seafarers is paramount, and we expect it to be fully respected. India will defend its interests firmly.

posts.text: Quarter after quarter, year after year, India remains the world's fastest-growing major economy. Even amid the West Asia crisis and disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz, India moves forward. There is no impending crisis — only steady progress.
posts.caption: Quarter after quarter, year after year, India remains the world's fastest-growing major economy. Even amid the West Asia crisis and disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz, India moves forward. There is no impending crisis — only steady progress.

posts.text: We are doubling down on India's energy transition — green hydrogen, solar manufacturing and world-class infrastructure. India's growth story will be powered by clean, self-reliant energy built on Indian soil.
posts.caption: We are doubling down on India's energy transition — green hydrogen, solar manufacturing and world-class infrastructure. India's growth story will be powered by clean, self-reliant energy built on Indian soil.

posts.text: Jio is bringing the power of true 5G and AI to every corner of India — connecting the next 500 million users and building a Digital Bharat that leaves no one behind.
posts.caption: Jio is bringing the power of true 5G and AI to every corner of India — connecting the next 500 million users and building a Digital Bharat that leaves no one behind.

posts.text: The Tata commitment has always been to give back to the communities and the nation we serve. True leadership is measured not by profits we earn, but by the lives we are able to uplift.
posts.caption: The Tata commitment has always been to give back to the communities and the nation we serve. True leadership is measured not by profits we earn, but by the lives we are able to uplift.

posts.text: President Droupadi Murmu salutes the courage of our armed forces and the resilience of every Indian. Rashtrapati Bhavan reaffirms the nation's enduring commitment to peace, unity and progress in these challenging times. 🇮🇳
posts.caption: President Droupadi Murmu salutes the courage of our armed forces and the resilience of every Indian. Rashtrapati Bhavan reaffirms the nation's enduring commitment to peace, unity and progress in these challenging times. 🇮🇳

posts.text: The Deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete. Congratulations to all! I hereby fully authorize the toll free opening of the Strait of Hormuz, and the immediate removal of the United States Naval blockade. Ships of the World, start your engines. Let the oil flow!
posts.caption: The Deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete. Congratulations to all! I hereby fully authorize the toll free opening of the Strait of Hormuz, and the immediate removal of the United States Naval blockade. Ships of the World, start your engines. Let the oil flow!

posts.text: Free markets, strong alliances and sound money remain the foundations of lasting prosperity. Britain must stay outward-looking, confident and serious on the world stage — that is how we secure our future.
posts.caption: Free markets, strong alliances and sound money remain the foundations of lasting prosperity. Britain must stay outward-looking, confident and serious on the world stage — that is how we secure our future.

posts.text: We will make Ohio the blueprint for an American comeback — merit, family and national pride over bureaucracy. The people are ready for real leadership and a return to common sense.
posts.caption: We will make Ohio the blueprint for an American comeback — merit, family and national pride over bureaucracy. The people are ready for real leadership and a return to common sense.

leaders.name: Usha Vance
leaders.role: Second Lady of the United States

posts.text: Honored to champion America's families and the values that bind us together. Service to this country, and to the children who are its future, is the privilege of a lifetime.
posts.caption: Honored to champion America's families and the values that bind us together. Service to this country, and to the children who are its future, is the privilege of a lifetime.

posts.text: The FBI's mission is simple: protect the American people and uphold the rule of law without fear or favor. Accountability and integrity are back, and the men and women of this Bureau make me proud every single day.
posts.caption: The FBI's mission is simple: protect the American people and uphold the rule of law without fear or favor. Accountability and integrity are back, and the men and women of this Bureau make me proud every single day.

leaders.name: Sriram Krishnan
leaders.role: White House Senior Policy Advisor, AI

posts.text: America must win the AI race by backing builders, open competition and the world's best technical talent. The next decade will be defined by what we choose to build right now.
posts.caption: America must win the AI race by backing builders, open competition and the world's best technical talent. The next decade will be defined by what we choose to build right now.

posts.text: At the World Bank, our north star is jobs — creating opportunity across developing economies and financing the energy and infrastructure that lifts people out of poverty. Growth must be inclusive to be real.
posts.caption: At the World Bank, our north star is jobs — creating opportunity across developing economies and financing the energy and infrastructure that lifts people out of poverty. Growth must be inclusive to be real.

posts.text: The UK stands firmly with Ukraine. Alongside our European allies, we are building the security guarantees that will deliver a just and lasting peace. Europe must help shape the path forward — and we will.
posts.caption: The UK stands firmly with Ukraine. Alongside our European allies, we are building the security guarantees that will deliver a just and lasting peace. Europe must help shape the path forward — and we will.

posts.text: My Government is focused on cost-of-living relief, cheaper energy and a Future Made in Australia. We're building a stronger, fairer economy that works for working families.
posts.caption: My Government is focused on cost-of-living relief, cheaper energy and a Future Made in Australia. We're building a stronger, fairer economy that works for working families.

posts.text: France is hosting the G7 in Évian with clear priorities: strengthening economic security, addressing global imbalances and coordinating on AI safety. We all need stability, calm and a return to peace. This is not a show.
posts.caption: France is hosting the G7 in Évian with clear priorities: strengthening economic security, addressing global imbalances and coordinating on AI safety. We all need stability, calm and a return to peace. This is not a show.

leaders.name: Mohammed bin Rashid
leaders.role: Vice President & PM of the UAE

posts.text: The UAE will remain a global home for talent, trade and innovation. We do not wait for the future — we build it. Our ambition has no ceiling, and our best days are always ahead.
posts.caption: The UAE will remain a global home for talent, trade and innovation. We do not wait for the future — we build it. Our ambition has no ceiling, and our best days are always ahead.

posts.text: If people had told me this was going to happen, I'd have said you must be smoking some really good crack. I gave SpaceX less than a 10% chance of succeeding at all. Thank you to an incredible team — now, onward to Mars.
posts.caption: If people had told me this was going to happen, I'd have said you must be smoking some really good crack. I gave SpaceX less than a 10% chance of succeeding at all. Thank you to an incredible team — now, onward to Mars.

posts.text: We're putting personal superintelligence in everyone's hands — AI that truly works for you, and the next generation of AI glasses. The future of computing is personal, and it's closer than people think.
posts.caption: We're putting personal superintelligence in everyone's hands — AI that truly works for you, and the next generation of AI glasses. The future of computing is personal, and it's closer than people think.

posts.text: Gemini is now helping billions of people across Search, Workspace and Android. We remain committed to making AI helpful for everyone — boldly and responsibly, at the scale only Google can deliver.
posts.caption: Gemini is now helping billions of people across Search, Workspace and Android. We remain committed to making AI helpful for everyone — boldly and responsibly, at the scale only Google can deliver.

posts.text: Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. With Copilot, AI is becoming the new UI for work — amplifying human ingenuity, not replacing it.
posts.caption: Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. With Copilot, AI is becoming the new UI for work — amplifying human ingenuity, not replacing it.

posts.text: We've confidentially filed for an IPO — it gives us optionality, though it may be a while. If we get this right, AI can become a foundation for greater productivity, creativity, scientific progress and opportunity for the many.
posts.caption: We've confidentially filed for an IPO — it gives us optionality, though it may be a while. If we get this right, AI can become a foundation for greater productivity, creativity, scientific progress and opportunity for the many.

posts.text: At Apple, we believe technology should enrich lives while fiercely protecting privacy. We're more excited than ever about what's ahead — especially as we bring intelligence to every device people love.
posts.caption: At Apple, we believe technology should enrich lives while fiercely protecting privacy. We're more excited than ever about what's ahead — especially as we bring intelligence to every device people love.

posts.text: We've reached the tipping point of accelerated computing. Every company, every industry, every country is becoming an AI factory. This is the beginning of a new industrial revolution — and we're just getting started.
posts.caption: We've reached the tipping point of accelerated computing. Every company, every industry, every country is becoming an AI factory. This is the beginning of a new industrial revolution — and we're just getting started.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, and now AI — is showing the world how to deliver at population scale. The next leap is putting the power of AI directly in the hands of every Indian.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, and now AI — is showing the world how to deliver at population scale. The next leap is putting the power of AI directly in the hands of every Indian.

posts.text: I've committed to giving away virtually all of my wealth through the Gates Foundation to fight disease and poverty. Innovation in health and clean energy can save and improve millions of lives — that's the work that matters most.
posts.caption: I've committed to giving away virtually all of my wealth through the Gates Foundation to fight disease and poverty. Innovation in health and clean energy can save and improve millions of lives — that's the work that matters most.

posts.text: AI and hybrid cloud are fundamentally reshaping the enterprise. At IBM, we're focused on building AI that businesses can trust — open, secure, and built for the real world, not the demo.
posts.caption: AI and hybrid cloud are fundamentally reshaping the enterprise. At IBM, we're focused on building AI that businesses can trust — open, secure, and built for the real world, not the demo.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are converging in extraordinary ways. At Adobe, we're empowering everyone to bring their ideas to life — responsibly, and always with creators at the center of everything we build.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are converging in extraordinary ways. At Adobe, we're empowering everyone to bring their ideas to life — responsibly, and always with creators at the center of everything we build.

posts.text: We're building the next layer of the internet — one made for AI agents as much as for humans. The web is being rebuilt for machines, and that's an extraordinary opportunity for anyone willing to build.
posts.caption: We're building the next layer of the internet — one made for AI agents as much as for humans. The web is being rebuilt for machines, and that's an extraordinary opportunity for anyone willing to build.

posts.text: Leadership, to me, is about humanity, courage and care. At Chanel, we're investing in craft, creativity and the remarkable people who make our house what it is. Put people first, and excellence follows.
posts.caption: Leadership, to me, is about humanity, courage and care. At Chanel, we're investing in craft, creativity and the remarkable people who make our house what it is. Put people first, and excellence follows.

posts.text: At FedEx, we're transforming global logistics with data and AI — making supply chains smarter, faster and more resilient for businesses of every size, everywhere in the world.
posts.caption: At FedEx, we're transforming global logistics with data and AI — making supply chains smarter, faster and more resilient for businesses of every size, everywhere in the world.

posts.text: Eighteen years for this one moment. Winning the IPL with RCB is a dream I will cherish forever. To the fans who never stopped believing through every high and low — thank you. This one is for you, Bengaluru. ❤️
posts.caption: Eighteen years for this one moment. Winning the IPL with RCB is a dream I will cherish forever. To the fans who never stopped believing through every high and low — thank you. This one is for you, Bengaluru. ❤️

posts.text: Great to be back out there with the boys and 1-0 up against Afghanistan. Disappointed to get run out, but the team result is all that matters. Brilliant stuff from the debutants and the skipper. On to Lucknow. 🇮🇳
posts.caption: Great to be back out there with the boys and 1-0 up against Afghanistan. Disappointed to get run out, but the team result is all that matters. Brilliant stuff from the debutants and the skipper. On to Lucknow. 🇮🇳

posts.text: Process over results, always. Whatever comes next, it'll be with the same calm, the same love for the game, and the same gratitude to the fans who've stood by me through it all.
posts.caption: Process over results, always. Whatever comes next, it'll be with the same calm, the same love for the game, and the same gratitude to the fans who've stood by me through it all.

posts.text: Feeling strong and ready to go. Nothing beats representing India — managing my workload smartly so I can give everything when it matters most for the team. The hunger never fades.
posts.caption: Feeling strong and ready to go. Nothing beats representing India — managing my workload smartly so I can give everything when it matters most for the team. The hunger never fades.

posts.text: Grateful for the journey and focused on coming back stronger for India. Hard work in silence — let the game do the talking. Onwards and upwards. 🙏
posts.caption: Grateful for the journey and focused on coming back stronger for India. Hard work in silence — let the game do the talking. Onwards and upwards. 🙏

posts.text: Wonderful to watch young India shine — Shubman Gill's form is an absolute joy. The future of Indian cricket is in safe and very talented hands. Keep flying, boys. 🇮🇳
posts.caption: Wonderful to watch young India shine — Shubman Gill's form is an absolute joy. The future of Indian cricket is in safe and very talented hands. Keep flying, boys. 🇮🇳

posts.text: The depth in Indian cricket right now is incredible. Exciting times ahead with this young side — back the youngsters, let them express themselves, and the results will follow.
posts.caption: The depth in Indian cricket right now is incredible. Exciting times ahead with this young side — back the youngsters, let them express themselves, and the results will follow.
